phases.name: Foundation Control
phases.goal: Create deterministic monorepo foundation, quality gates and security baseline without product behavior.
phases.exit_gate: workspaces, TypeScript, tests, lint, coverage command, env baseline and tracking JSON are present and validated

phases.name: Shared Contracts
phases.goal: Create shared contracts consumed by every app and package.
phases.exit_gate: all shared schemas have unit tests and package exports are stable

phases.name: Persistence and Data Integrity
phases.goal: Create database schema, repositories, idempotency and audit storage.
phases.exit_gate: repositories pass integration tests with transactional behavior

phases.name: Agent Core and Application Commands
phases.goal: Implement application commands without external integrations.
phases.exit_gate: commands from SPEC 0106 pass contract and integration tests

phases.name: Policy, Approvals and Tools
phases.goal: Guarantee safety fail-closed before workflows call tools.
phases.exit_gate: policy, approval and tool registry tests pass

phases.name: Workflows MVP
phases.goal: Implement the MVP workflows with safety and handoff.
phases.exit_gate: all MVP workflow tests pass and sensitive actions remain blocked

phases.name: API and Worker Runtime
phases.goal: Expose operational endpoints and async processing.
phases.exit_gate: API contract tests and worker integration tests pass

phases.name: Operational Web Panel
phases.goal: Provide a minimal human operations surface.
phases.entry_gate: P6 completed and role mapping approved for real use
phases.exit_gate: web tests and critical Playwright flows pass

phases.name: Adapters, Memory and Safe RAG
phases.goal: Prepare replaceable integrations without unsafe real-world coupling.
phases.exit_gate: fake adapters and source-gated RAG pass tests

phases.name: Observability, Security and Hardening
phases.goal: Make runtime auditable, measurable and resilient.
phases.exit_gate: audit report has no critical open gaps

phases.name: Controlled Rollout Readiness
phases.goal: Prepare human-assisted pilot without changing MVP scope.
phases.entry_gate: P9 completed and human approvals for data governance are recorded

controlled_sprints.name: Pre-production tenant isolation boundary
controlled_sprints.goal: Enforce tenant isolation at the PostgreSQL boundary without real-data activation.
controlled_sprints.entry_gate: PLAT-S02 controlled gate complete and human decision retained for real-data backfill
controlled_sprints.exit_gate: Versioned migration, forced RLS fixture evidence, tenant-scoped pool and production startup guard pass

controlled_sprints.name: Durable approval, safe legacy adapter and runtime reliability
controlled_sprints.goal: Make approval single-use and durable, and route only the controlled scheduling read through the capability gateway.
controlled_sprints.entry_gate: PLAT-S03 controlled gate complete; no real provider/channel activation
controlled_sprints.exit_gate: Durable approval replay/expiry/revocation/input-hash tests, allowlist-only dry-run adapter, tenant-scoped runtime wiring, pending/completed retry, atomic finalization and controlled raw-body HMAC/replay tests pass

controlled_sprints.name: Controlled model provider identity boundary
controlled_sprints.goal: Resolve only the compiled fake/deterministic-v1 model identity in controlled execution and fail closed for unsupported references.
controlled_sprints.entry_gate: PLAT-S39 controlled gate complete and SPEC_APPROVED_CONTROLLED_BUILD
controlled_sprints.exit_gate: Focused and integrated tests prove exact registry resolution, early rejection of unknown provider/model/fallback, and no external calls or side effects

controlled_sprints.name: Controlled output safety boundary
controlled_sprints.goal: Validate and safely rewrite model/template/knowledge output before response delivery in controlled execution.
controlled_sprints.entry_gate: PLAT-S40 controlled gate complete and SPEC_APPROVED_CONTROLLED_BUILD
controlled_sprints.exit_gate: Focused and integrated tests prove bounded typed/redacted output, Unicode/confusable unsafe-content rejection, safe fallback, coherent handoff state/events, no raw rejected text, and no tool/approval execution after rewrite

controlled_sprints.name: Controlled trace provenance boundary
controlled_sprints.goal: Canonicalize and validate every controlled TestRunTrace at direct, suite and PostgreSQL read/write boundaries.
controlled_sprints.entry_gate: PLAT-S41 controlled gate complete and SPEC_APPROVED_CONTROLLED_BUILD
controlled_sprints.exit_gate: Focused and integrated tests prove allowlisted bounded traces, controlled provider identity, output-policy consistency, suite parity, and fail-closed PostgreSQL reads/writes without unsafe return or side effect

controlled_sprints.name: Controlled trace temporal integrity
controlled_sprints.goal: Enforce coherent controlled trace timestamps, latency and ordered span status without external telemetry.
controlled_sprints.entry_gate: PLAT-S42 controlled gate complete and SPEC_APPROVED_CONTROLLED_BUILD
controlled_sprints.exit_gate: Focused and integrated tests prove temporal, ordinal and derived-status invariants fail closed while optional legacy telemetry remains compatible

controlled_sprints.name: Controlled trace stage timing
controlled_sprints.goal: Measure controlled trace stages with an injectable monotonic clock without external telemetry.
controlled_sprints.entry_gate: PLAT-S43 controlled gate complete and SPEC_APPROVED_CONTROLLED_BUILD
controlled_sprints.exit_gate: Focused and integrated tests prove finite measured durations, skipped-zero behavior, bounded sum and no payload/export side effect

controlled_sprints.name: Controlled tool invocation boundary
controlled_sprints.goal: Validate compiled tool invocation inputs and outputs, authorize the effective actor, bind durable approvals and project handler results before execution and return.
controlled_sprints.entry_gate: PLAT-S44 controlled gate complete and SPEC_APPROVED_CONTROLLED_BUILD
controlled_sprints.exit_gate: Focused and integrated tests prove server-side input/output validation, effective actor authorization, durable single-use approval binding, bounded result projection, no premature consumption, no replay after audit failure and no raw payload return

controlled_sprints.name: Controlled execution trace correlation boundary
controlled_sprints.goal: Resolve one bounded trace identity before execution events and propagate it through the controlled kernel, hooks, tools, audits and trace sinks.
controlled_sprints.entry_gate: PLAT-S45 controlled gate complete and SPEC_APPROVED_CONTROLLED_BUILD
controlled_sprints.exit_gate: Focused and integrated tests prove one traceId per execution, event/hook/tool-audit propagation, early invalid-ID rejection, sink preservation and compatibility of local event/call IDs

controlled_sprints.name: Controlled multi-agent creation mode
controlled_sprints.goal: Provide an explicit Control Center create-agent mode so one tenant can create Agent A and Agent B with independent configuration snapshots through the same kernel.
controlled_sprints.entry_gate: PLAT-S46 controlled gate complete and SPEC_APPROVED_CONTROLLED_BUILD
controlled_sprints.exit_gate: UI/API journey proves new-agent reset, same-session A/B creation, isolated derived state and preserved version cloning without external effects
